args.subject: Invoice Update & Late Fee Refund Confirmation
args.body:
Dear Litware Ltd,

Your billing contact has been updated to **accounts@litware.ai**. Future invoices will be sent to this address.

Additionally, your **late fee refund of 240** has been processed and will reflect in your account within 3–5 business days. Confirmation notifications will be sent to the updated email.

Thank you for your patience.

—IT Operations Team

args.note: Resolved: Updated billing contact to accounts@litware.ai and issued refund of 240. Customer confirmed via email.
